name: text2html2png
description: Turn structured text into polished HTML diagrams, with optional PNG export on request.

interface.shortDescription: Polished HTML diagrams with optional PNG export.
interface.longDescription: Create local-first flowcharts, comparisons, timelines, architecture maps, dashboards, Gantt charts, org charts, funnels, and narrative briefs as editable HTML. Export a high-resolution PNG only when requested.
defaultPrompt: Turn this process into a polished HTML flowchart.
Map this system as a dark architecture diagram and export a PNG.
Compare these options in a clear visual matrix.
